description:
Navigate to the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) and look up the physical properties for four industrial solvents: Acetone (CAS 67-64-1), Toluene (CAS 108-88-3), Methanol (CAS 67-56-1), and Ethyl Acetate (CAS 141-78-6). 

For each chemical, find the 'Physical Properties' section and record the Vapor Pressure and Boiling Point. 

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/vapor_hazard_report.txt' that lists these properties for all four chemicals. Based on the data, identify which chemical has the HIGHEST vapor pressure and therefore poses the greatest inhalation hazard. 

The report must include:
1. A list of all four chemicals with their Vapor Pressure and Boiling Point values (include units).
2. A clear ranking or statement identifying the chemical with the highest vapor pressure.
